name: mizan-sense-wsd
dataset_note: Derived weights + sense inventory only. The dataset itself (Q-CSMP v2) is NOT redistributed. Train = Q-CSMP v2 base train split with PR-41's 9 frozen label-noise merges (nlp/SENSE_MERGES.json) PLUS Phase-A's 9 MASAQ-grounded merges (nlp/SENSE_MERGES_PHASEA.json, Juber REVISE spec v2, frozen): عَلِيم all knowing→all knower, خالِد abiding forever→abide forever, خالِد will abide forever→abide forever, شَهِيد witnesses→witness, عَدُوّ enemies→enemy, مُؤْمِن believing men→believer, كَثِير much→many, أَكْثَر most of→most, بَعْض some of you→some of. Inventory 106→97 senses, 1,005 training records relabeled. أَيّ #1–#2 (mankind/you who believe) HELD for the vocative micro-phase.
architecture: per-lemma sklearn LogisticRegression (lbfgs, C=1.0); char 2-4-gram surface+context features (variant 'a') + optional morph family (variant 'b'); single-sense lemmas use a constant prior predictor
eval_protocol: whole-surah holdout, single test run on the frozen Phase-1 test split (n=627), gold labels merged to the 97-sense space; macro-F1 over the full 97-sense universe (absent senses contribute 0.0). Win bar = remapped-baseline comparator (spec v2 §5.2): EXACT Phase-A mapping applied to frozen baseline y_true AND y_pred first, then retrained model compared on the same collapsed ontology — 4/4 gates PASS.
trust_boundary: model.joblib is a pickle-family file. The loader validates this manifest (schema + files + sha256 checksums) BEFORE unpickling, and loads ONLY from the packaged artifacts/default/ directory or an operator-set MIZAN_NLP_ARTIFACT dir. Never load remote/untrusted files.

win_bar.comparator: remapped baseline (exact Phase-A mapping applied to frozen baseline y_true+y_pred)

target_recall.detail: all 8 affected targets: new recall >= remapped-baseline pooled recall (all 1.0)

honest_note: Retrained model predictions are BIT-FOR-BIT identical to the remapped baseline (627/627 test items, 16 decimals). All measured gain (+0.0112 accuracy, +0.0151 macro-F1 vs the 106-sense baseline) comes from ontology simplification, not from retraining. Ship decision: native retrained artifact chosen over remap-shim (operator override of JEV ship_remap_only conf 0.27) — no shim stacking; أَيّ:vocative follow-up composes cleanly to 96 senses.

reproducibility.mapping_composition: Q-CSMP v2 115 labels -> PR-41 mapping (nlp/SENSE_MERGES.json) -> 106 baseline -> Phase-A mapping (nlp/SENSE_MERGES_PHASEA.json) -> 97 final

eval_note: Bootstrap CIs not recomputed for Phase-A; point estimates on frozen n=627 split. (v1.1.0 CIs were 106-sense space, not comparable.)
